rules.statement: `min` is no greater than `max` where durations compare: one is no greater than another when it has no more years and months and no more days, hours, minutes and seconds, as `P14D` and `P30D`, or `PT48H` and `P3D`; a pair neither bounds, as `P1M` and `P30D`, the text doesn't order.
`min` is no greater than `max`: numbers compare as numbers, and timestamps as instants.

standard.name: ISO 4217, Codes for the representation of currencies

rules.statement: A CurrencyCode MUST be an alphabetic code that ISO 4217 currently assigns.

standard.name: IANA Time Zone Database, zone names

rules.statement: A `TimeZone` other than `viewer_local` MUST be a zone name that the IANA time zone database lists.
